_comment: Curated drug interactions database. Each entry lists two drugs (lowercase generic names) and the severity/description of their interaction. Severity: 'severe', 'moderate', 'mild'.

interactions.description: Combining warfarin and aspirin sharply increases the risk of serious bleeding. Avoid unless prescribed together by a doctor.
Ibuprofen can increase the bleeding risk of warfarin. Use paracetamol instead when possible.
Taking ibuprofen with aspirin may reduce the cardioprotective effect of aspirin and increase stomach bleeding.
Combining paracetamol (acetaminophen) with alcohol increases the risk of liver damage.
Drinking alcohol while taking metformin increases the risk of lactic acidosis and hypoglycemia.
Amoxicillin can raise methotrexate levels and increase its toxicity.
Increases the risk of central nervous system stimulation and seizures.
Amlodipine increases simvastatin blood levels — keep simvastatin dose at 20 mg or below.
Clarithromycin can dramatically raise simvastatin levels, causing muscle damage (rhabdomyolysis).
Ibuprofen reduces the blood-pressure-lowering effect of lisinopril and may harm kidney function.
Both raise potassium levels — combining them risks dangerous hyperkalemia.
Risk of serotonin syndrome — a potentially life-threatening reaction.
SSRIs combined with NSAIDs increase the risk of gastrointestinal bleeding.
Risk of serotonin syndrome. Monitor for agitation, fever, and rapid heart rate.
Omeprazole may reduce the effectiveness of clopidogrel.
Amiodarone increases digoxin levels — risk of toxicity. Reduce digoxin dose.
Both slow the heart — combining them can cause severe bradycardia or heart block.
Calcium reduces doxycycline absorption. Separate doses by at least 2 hours.
Calcium reduces levothyroxine absorption. Take at least 4 hours apart.
Omeprazole may reduce absorption of levothyroxine.
